scope: Diffusion-internal mask placement. Applied after the stage-1 mask filter, before inpainting. Does not change shared QC.
method: translation only: crop the mask to its bounding box, pick a random foreground pixel as the box centre (clipped to the image), accept the first position whose mask-on-foreground overlap >= min_overlap
foreground: shared QC estimate_object_foreground() on the same training-normal source image, nearest-resized with the QC's own _resize_binary_mask() to the 256x256 output grid
known_limits: object-aware but not part-aware (does not know thread vs head) and no rotation to follow the object axis
